Na drahý dopis [nesmírně?] se těší a [Tebe?] [nesčíslněkráte?] líbá Tvůj [Pepouš?].

Warm [thanks?], dear [Andulko?], [for?] the [beautiful?] [card?]! I am in the office from morning until evening. I do not yet know [when?] I will [be able?] to go [home?], I am always thinking of [you?].
